Question: Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding loss reserve amount by agent id, policy number and claim number
Generated Query:
SELECT
    a.Agent_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    ca.Claim_Amount AS loss_reserve_amount
FROM Loss_Reserve lr
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN Agent a
    ON a.Agent_Identifier = p.Agent_Identifier
ORDER BY
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;

What is the average time to settle a claim by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) * 1.0) AS Average_Time_To_Settle_Days
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

What is the total loss of each policy by policy number where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(lp.total_loss_payment, 0)
    + COALESCE(lr.total_loss_reserve, 0)
    + COALESCE(ep.total_expense_payment, 0)
    + COALESCE(er.total_expense_reserve, 0) AS total_loss
FROM Policy p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(cp.Amount) AS total_loss_payment
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Payment cp
        ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Payment lpay
        ON lpay.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Policy_Identifier
) lp
    ON lp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(cr.Amount) AS total_loss_reserve
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
        ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Reserve lres
        ON lres.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Policy_Identifier
) lr
    ON lr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(cp.Amount) AS total_expense_payment
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Payment cp
        ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Expense_Payment epay
        ON epay.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Policy_Identifier
) ep
    ON ep.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(cr.Amount) AS total_expense_reserve
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
        ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Expense_Reserve eres
        ON eres.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Policy_Identifier
) er
    ON er.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;
